recipe.visualDefinition: A central circular emblem containing a hybrid musical-judicial icon. The icon features an electric guitar neck acting as the fulcrum for a set of scales, with the guitar body integrated into two theatrical masks (comedy and tragedy) resting on a piano keyboard base. The entire scene is set against a radial blue gradient with scattered stars, framed by a thick metallic ring.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between the left and right scale pans and theatrical masks
Vertical alignment of the guitar neck with the central axis
Contrast between the warm gold highlights and cool blue background
Circular containment of the complex symbolic elements
coreInvariants: Metallic chrome and gold surface treatments
Hybridization of musical instruments and classical symbols
Five-pointed stars scattered within the inner circle

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central circular emblem occupying 70% of the frame, centered both horizontally and vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical guitar neck and microphone headstock at the dead center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top text, drops to the central guitar neck, follows the horizontal scale arms outward, and circles back via the metallic frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep navy blue corners provide high contrast for the glowing central circle.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cerulean to navy blue radial gradient for the background and inner circle.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool silver/chrome for the scale structure and outer ring.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm gold/brass highlights on the scale arms, stars, and typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright metallic icons and the dark, saturated blue periphery.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to blues, silvers, and golds to maintain the airbrushed 80s/90s aesthetic.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick verticals and thin horizontals
Wide, open counters in the 'A' and 'B'
Metallic gold texture with inner beveling
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'L' has a slightly extended horizontal foot to balance the tracking.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Standalone display serif for maximum impact.

candidateDirections.reason: High contrast and sharp serifs match the elegant, formal tone.
Classic structure that supports the metallic beveling well.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a square airbrushed illustration. The background is a radial gradient from bright cerulean blue in the center to deep navy blue at the edges. In the center, a large metallic silver and gold circular frame contains a symmetrical emblem. The emblem consists of a vertical electric guitar neck with a microphone head, acting as the beam for a pair of scales. The base of the guitar is merged with two theatrical masks (comedy and tragedy) facing outward, resting on a piano keyboard. Five-pointed stars are scattered around the scales. The style is polished, metallic, and surrealist.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the title text at the top in a large, all-caps, high-contrast serif font. Apply a gold metallic gradient and a beveled 3D effect to the letters. Space the letters widely across the top third of the image.

verificationChecks: Is the central emblem perfectly symmetrical?
Does the typography have a metallic, beveled texture?
Is the background a smooth radial blue gradient?
Are the musical and judicial elements clearly integrated?

mustAchieve: Perfect horizontal symmetry in the emblem
Smooth airbrushed transitions in the blue background

postGenerationChecks: Check that the guitar neck is perfectly vertical.
Ensure the text is centered and legible against the dark background.
Verify the metallic textures look reflective and not flat.
Confirm the scale pans are level.
